name: Heavy-Lift Starcrosser
description: The Heavy-Lift Starcrosser was a model of ore transport that was used by the Daimanate during the time of the New Sith Wars. In 1032 BBY, a team of Jedi led by Jedi Master Vannar Treece stole a Starcrosser from the planet Oranessan, as part of Operation Influx.
